description: Exact lookup of a regulatory identifier: 510(k), PMA or De Novo number, UDI-DI or EU Basic UDI-DI. Returns the devices whose primary reference or UDI-DI is that identifier (exact_matches) and devices that carry it elsewhere (related; a Basic UDI-DI or a submission number usually covers several device models).

identifier.description: A 510(k) number (K123456), PMA number (P123456), De Novo number (DEN123456), UDI-DI (GS1 GTIN such as 00884838023703, or HIBCC) or EU Basic UDI-DI. Spaces and letter case are ignored.

name: find_device_by_identifier
title: Find a device by identifier
